objective_pt: Resolver situações de banco e pagamento (abrir conta, sacar dinheiro, cartão recusado) e falar sobre gastar e economizar com "spend on", "save up for" e "afford".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando de hábitos com dinheiro.
prompts: Are you a saver or a spender?
How do you usually pay for things?
watchFor: Dizer "I pay with card"; é "I pay by card" ou "with my card".

exercises.prompt: Will you be paying by card or in cash?
accepted: Will you be paying by card or in cash
Will you be paying by card or cash
Are you paying by card or in cash

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que vai pagar com cartão.
exercises.listen: How would you like to pay?
accepted: By card, please
By card
I'll pay by card
I'll pay by card, please
Card, please
With my card, please
I'd like to pay by card
Credit card, please
By credit card

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Forma de pagamento com cartão é "by card" (ou "with my card"). Em dinheiro é "in cash".

exercises.explanation_pt: Economizar é "save". "Economize" existe, mas é formal e raro na conversa.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender o vocabulário de banco e de finanças pessoais.
prompts: What do you spend most of your money on?
Is there something you're saving up for?
watchFor: Dizer "spend in clothes"; é "spend on clothes".

exercises.example_en: I can't afford a new car right now.
I'm saving up for a trip to Chile.
I need to withdraw some cash before we go.
I'm sorry, your card has been declined.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você pode me emprestar vinte reais?"
accepted: Can you lend me twenty reais
Could you lend me twenty reais
Can you lend me 20 reais
Could you lend me 20 reais
Can I borrow twenty reais
Could I borrow twenty reais
Can I borrow 20 reais from you

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Borrow" é pegar emprestado. Para pedir que alguém empreste a você, use "lend me" ou "Can I borrow...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you lend me twenty reais?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O verbo mais natural para emprestar a alguém é "lend": "Can you lend me...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you lend me twenty reais?

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar valores em dinheiro e as palavras "debt" e "receipt" (letras mudas).
prompts: How do you say R$ 49.90 in English?
Say "debt". Is there a B sound?
watchFor: Ler valores como em português ("quarenta e nove vírgula noventa"); em inglês: "forty-nine ninety".

exercises.prompt: I want to pay off my debt this year.
accepted: I want to pay off my debt this year
I wanna pay off my debt this year

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita o valor do jeito que se fala em inglês.
accepted: That comes to forty-nine ninety
That comes to forty nine ninety
That comes to 49.90

teacher.goal_pt: Entender situações de banco e pagamento e responder.
prompts: Your card was declined. What do you say?
watchFor: Dizer "cash machine" e "ATM" está ok; "electronic box" não.
Esquecer o artigo: "I want to open account".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça o atendente do banco e escolha o que ele explicou.
exercises.listen: There's no monthly fee for this account, but you'll pay two dollars every time you use another bank's ATM.
options: A conta tem tarifa mensal de dois dólares.
Não há tarifa mensal, mas cobra dois dólares por saque em caixa de outro banco.
exercises.explanation_pt: "No monthly fee" = sem tarifa mensal; "two dollars every time you use another bank's ATM" = dois dólares por uso de caixa de outro banco.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que quer abrir uma conta.
exercises.listen: Good morning. What can I do for you today?
accepted: I'd like to open an account
I would like to open an account
I'd like to open a bank account
I want to open an account
Good morning. I'd like to open an account
I'd like to open a new account, please
Hi, I'd like to open an account, please

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Account" é contável e precisa de artigo: "open an account".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'd like to open an account.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Conta bancária é "account". "Count" é contar ou conde.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'd like to open an account.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e peça para tentar de novo com outro cartão.
exercises.listen: I'm sorry, your card has been declined.
accepted: Can I try another card
Could I try another card
Can I try a different card
Oh, can I try another card
Let me try another card
Can I try again with another card
Could I try with a different card

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Outro cartão" é "another card" (uma palavra só) ou "a different card".

teacher.goal_pt: Conversar sobre hábitos de dinheiro: gastos, economias e metas.
prompts: What do you spend too much money on?
What are you saving up for?
Is it a good idea to lend money to friends?
watchFor: "I can't afford to buy" é ok; "I don't have money for buy" não.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu gasto muito dinheiro com comida."
accepted: I spend a lot of money on food
I spend lots of money on food
I spend too much money on food
I spend a lot on food
I spend so much money on food
I spend a lot of money on eating

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Gastar com" é "spend on": "I spend a lot of money on food".
commonErrors.correction_en: I spend a lot of money on food.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Gastar" dinheiro é "spend". "Expend" é formal e se usa para energia ou recursos.
commonErrors.correction_en: I spend a lot of money on food.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu não tenho condições de comprar um carro agora."
accepted: I can't afford a car right now
I can't afford to buy a car right now
I can't afford a car now
I cannot afford a car right now
I can't afford to buy a car now
I don't have enough money for a car right now
I don't have enough money to buy a car right now

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Não ter condições" (dinheiro) é "can't afford". "Conditions" é tradução literal.
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't afford a car right now.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "money" use "to buy" ou "for a car": "money to buy a car".
commonErrors.correction_en: I don't have enough money to buy a car right now.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: I'm saving up for a new laptop.

exercises.instruction_pt: Fale sobre a sua relação com dinheiro.
exercises.prompt_en: Are you better at saving or spending money? What are you saving up for right now?
guidelines_pt: Diga com o que você gasta mais: "I spend most of my money on...".
Fale de uma meta: "I'm saving up for...".
Dê uma dica de economia: "One thing that helps me save is...".

prompts: Have you ever lent money to someone?
What can't you afford right now?

exercises.prompt: Could you split the bill, please? We'll pay separately.
accepted: Could you split the bill, please? We'll pay separately
Could you split the bill please? We will pay separately
Could you split the bill? We'll pay separately

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Onde fica o caixa eletrônico mais próximo?"
accepted: Where's the nearest ATM
Where is the nearest ATM
Where's the nearest cash machine
Where is the closest ATM
Where's the closest ATM
Is there an ATM near here
Where can I find the nearest ATM

exercises.explanation_pt: Quem pede para usar algo emprestado diz "Can I borrow...?". Quem dá diz "I can lend you...".

exercises.sentence: She spends half her salary ___ rent.
accepted: on

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Spend money" leva "on": "spends half her salary on rent".
commonErrors.correction_en: She spends half her salary on rent.
